definitions.ask: Should the TODAY tooltip and the `bob plan` meter say how many off-clock links were left out?
definitions.why: Without a note the TODAY count silently stops matching the links visible in the ledger.

choices.label: Tooltip and `bob plan` add "N off-clock uncapped" so a smaller count is explained
Only JSON `off_clock` reports them; visible text changes only by the smaller count

definitions.ask: Should a new decisions record capture the off-clock-links-are-uncapped rule?
